pr_title: modbus: serial : Adding support for serial async
pr_body:
Async serial support is implemented by adding serial async functions in modbus_serial and by adding a choice for the serial driver in Kconfig. 
Tested on nucleo_g474re using rtu_server and rtu_client modbus samples. I've ran the sample up to 10625000 Baud reliably.

Fixes #52568

Signed-off-by: Jean Alinei <jean.alinei@laas.fr>

issue_context.title: Modbus - Adding support for serial async
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**

Async serial is supported in zephyr but modbus subsystem to not provide compatibility with the async API. Async has the great advantage of leveraging DMA to relieve CPU of having to deal with incoming messages interupts. 
Also, some RS485 transceivers are meant for high speed (Up to 10Mbits is defined in the official spec) but leveraging these speeds with current modbus subsytem is not possible with IRQ serial driver. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
The proposed enhancement would be implement a call to the Async Uart API in modbus_serial.c and to be able to choose with driver to operate from Kconfig.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
None

**Additional context**
None
